items.title: Capital Group Growth (CGGR) Adds Rocket and Deere on Nov. 6
items.summary: The fund bought $92.4 million of Rocket and $87.4 million of Deere, with net buying of $298.5 million against $516.4 million in gross trading.

items.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Kla-Tencor (KLAC) on Nov. 6
items.summary: ETFs sold $140.6 million in Kla-Tencor stock on Friday, Nov. 6.

items.title: Amtech, Intel, Applied Materials, AMD, and KLA Corporation shares are soaring, what you need to know
items.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the morning session after dip-buyers moved into beaten-down semiconductor and hardware names following the sector's steepest one-day rout in 19 months.

items.title: Alphabet Almost Sets a Record No One Wants
items.summary: Alphabet lost nearly $500 billion -- a staggering amount of market cap --reflecting investors’ negativity regarding its incredible spending on AI infrastructure.

items.title: Cathie Wood and 73 Other Funds Bought Chip Stocks. Cerebras Is Down 59% Since. Time to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCathie Wood’s ARK and dozens of other funds held Cerebras (CBRS:NASDAQ), Intel (INTC:NASDAQ), KLA (KLAC:NASDAQ), Applied Materials (AMAT:NASDAQ), or Lam Research (LRCX:NASDAQ) as of June 30, and all five stocks have fallen 53% to 59% since. Cerebras was a new holding for every fund that owned it.

items.title: AMAT to Post Q4 Earnings: Time to Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: Applied Materials heads into Q4 FY26 with strong AI-driven chip equipment demand, advanced packaging growth and rising memory investments.

items.title: LRCX Gains 8% on a $25B Buyback Plan: Is the Stock Worth Holding Now?
items.summary: Lam Research shares jump 8.2% on a $25B buyback plan. Strong AI demand, record earnings and a lower valuation support holding the stock.

items.title: Brad Gerstner Bought Applied Materials. A $16 Billion Hedge Fund Sold Nearly All of It. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBrad Gerstner’s Altimeter Capital opened a $189 million position in Applied Materials in the second quarter, while Maverick Capital, a $16 billion hedge fund, sold 99. 7% of its stake.
